title: Cancellation of a strict quotient presentation on unit sections
statement: Fix ordinary quotient model M and complex P, a strict quotient presentation isomorphism a from M.quotient(P) to C, and finite presentation comparisons kappa satisfying evaluation(a) followed by kappa equals M.evaluation. At every level n, degree i and pro-etale object U, a inverse sends the sequence section corresponding to kappa inverse of the quotient tensor 1 tensor x to the normalized quotient-unit section of M at x. The assertion includes the specified evaluation section casts and has no good-complex hypothesis. The notation is that of [def-trf-completion-unit-models], [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models].

source.place: 03D7, ordinary scalar-extension adjunction; 03EK, tensor products. Fully proved ordinary substep of the strict scalar quotient comparison.

proof.text: Invert the presentation comparison equation and take its degree-i component. Apply that equality to the tensor 1 tensor x. Evaluation of the presentation inverse on the corresponding sequence section is the same section as M.evaluation inverse applied to 1 tensor x, because the evaluation casts are HEq to identity.
Use the normalized finite quotient-adjunction unit formula to identify 1 tensor x with the finite unit section. This is precisely the definition of the quotient-unit section; undo the section casts.

proof_origin.place: Ordinary balanced tensor and adjunction-unit naturality; fully proved private implementation helper, not a new sorry obligation.

theorem presentationUnit
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W)
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ)
    (a : (M.quotient l E W).obj P ≅ C)
    (κ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E W n).obj P)
    (hκ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapIso a ≪≫
        κ n = (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (M.evaluation n) (.up ℤ)).app P)
    (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X i).val.obj U) :
    (a.inv.f i).val.app (op (n, U.unop))
      (integralComparisonSequenceSection l E W (C.X i) n U
        (((κ n).inv.f i).val.app U
          (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E W n (P.X i) U 1 x))) =
      CoefficientExtensionAssociation.quotientUnitSection l E W M (P.X i) n U x
